author: gobernment
body:
A traditional grounded KoTH map with a spin. Building is allowed in all forms except a small radius around hills. This is exclusively for Atlas, so therefore XML/YML will not be made until further notice. CPS in title = Capture Points, not Clicks per second.

Two Hills:
- Courtyard (Back hill)
- Center (Middle hill)

Thanks to alexanderjoe to hosting the server.

Map Download (if zip is needed, zamzar it or use WinRAR)
Map XML (not yet up)
Map Images (currently using DokuCraft, will get new images)

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body: KoTH means King of the Hill, where you have to control and stake the hill from the other team. It's basically CTH but in a different and sleeker form. It will be new and upcoming in Atlas, and as for it being small, funky needed testing maps more than anything so this is where Silent as Violent comes in. I'm open to expanding or rebuilding it if requested.
